title: Enable Password Encryption
description: Ensure Cisco password encryption service is enabled to avoid plaintext storage.

title: Disable Unencrypted HTTP Server
description: Unencrypted HTTP web management must be disabled in favor of HTTPS or SSH.

title: Enforce SSH Version 2
description: Legacy SSH version 1 is vulnerable to MITM attacks and should be upgraded to v2.

title: Disable Telnet / Enforce SSH on VTY Lines
description: VTY remote management lines must only accept SSH transport.

title: Restricted Access-Class on VTY
description: Administrative access lines must be restricted to management subnets via ACL.

title: Configure Login Banner (MOTD)
description: A warning banner must be configured to inform unauthorized users of monitoring.
